# Code Link

> A local terminal companion for Windows, macOS, Android and iOS, maintained by ZARADEE.

Monitor Windows terminal output, send text and keys, respond to approvals, and receive individual (A) or grouped (B) completion notifications from an Android tablet. USB and Bluetooth transports work locally without a relay server. The current Android release is 1.4.0. Windows / Android offer zh-CN and en packages; Apple clients use English. Package filenames identify the language.

## Crawling

Public website pages contain static HTML, canonical and hreflang links, and SoftwareApplication metadata. The sitemap is https://zaradee.github.io/code_LINK/sitemap.xml. This documentation index is a supplemental convention. Project-path robots.txt is a template for the user-site root and does not override root crawling policy.

## Scope

Targets: Windows x64, Android 9+, macOS 14+ and iOS / iPadOS 17+. Existing Windows Terminal mappings follow the active tab. External terminal completion detection requires supported screen markers; structured Codex events are available through clink codex. LAN is implemented but hardware acceptance is pending. Apple clients use local TLS; macOS runs managed PTYs and local Codex sessions. iOS pauses in the background. There is no signed iPhone IPA or TestFlight release; a simulator app and personal-signing source are provided. Mac apps are ad-hoc signed and not notarized. Linux and WSL remain unvalidated. Code uses MIT; supplied artwork and third-party components have separate terms.

## Complete workflows
